chunks: But how will you comprehend what 'Illiyun is?

key_terms.عِلِّيُّونَ: The highest register or abode of the righteous, mentioned in the Quran as a place of eternal reward.

ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Illiyun is often interpreted not merely as a physical location but as the spiritual station of the highest degree of closeness to God, particularly associated with the Imams and the righteous faithful. This rhetorical question underscores the transcendence of divine reward beyond human comprehension, linking the concept to the eternal legacy of the Ahl al-Bayt. The verse thus serves as a reminder of the ultimate destiny for those who uphold justice and piety in the face of worldly deceit.
